canopy.e: 中古英语 canapie, 法语 canapé sofa, 古法语 conopée, conopeu, conopieu, canopy, vail, pavilion (参见 意大利语 canopè canopy, sofa), 后期拉丁语 conopeum a bed with mosquito curtains, 源自 希腊语 kwnwpei^on, 源自 kw`nwps gnat, kw`nos cone + 'w`ps face. 见 Cone, and Optic.

cantaloupe.e: 法语 cantaloup, 意大利语 cantalupo, so called from the caste of Cantalupo, in the Marca d'Ancona, in Italy, where they were first grown in Europe, from seed said to have been imported from Armenia.

canticle.e: 拉丁语 canticulum a little song, 指小词 of canticum song, 源自 cantus a singing, 源自 coner to sing. 见 Chant.

canto.e: 意大利语 canto, 源自 拉丁语 cantus singing, song. 见 Chant.

canton.e: 法语 canton, augm. of 古法语 cant edge, corner. 见 1st Cant.

canvass.e: 古法语 Canabasser to examine curiously, to search or sift out; properly, to sift through canvas. 见 Canvas, n.
